g.text: Metabolic support for each class a multi-class system lists

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Source: data/qc/q2_support_system_class.csv (from p18 listing basis + p12 genome_enzyme_loci / function- & neighbour-linked loci). Number = genome enzymes / linked enzymes.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Genome enzymes = genes in the strain with a KEGG reaction on a listed compound of the class (could consume it); linked = also neighbour-linked or sharing a curated role with the system.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Dot size grows with genome enzymes (capped at 40). Hollow dot = 0 genome enzymes (e.g. no KEGG reactions on peptides).
